effective_date_basis: Section 7 makes the order effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on May 29, 2003, distinct from signing May 28.

exceptions_savings.assessment: The preamble revokes eight orders, but section 1 preserves pending proceedings, prior acts, matured rights or duties and incurred penalties. It expressly continues blocked-property transaction prohibitions under EO12808 and EO13088. EO13219 is amended, not revoked. Annex pages 4-8 lack text transcription; no complete inventory of EO13304 is asserted.
leads: Continuing blocked-property prohibitions prevent a blanket inference of substantive cessation.
Review section 1 savings and subsequent OFAC licensing or releases for each target.

legal_effect: Research lead only. Express revocation/supersession does not establish first substantive cessation, extinguish saved effects or change any provisional status.
quoted_clause:
I, GEORGE W. BUSH, President of the United States of America, have 
determined that the situations that gave rise to the declarations of national 
emergencies in Executive Order 12808 of May 30, 1992, and Executive 
Order 13088 of June 9, 1998, with respect to the former Socialist Federal 
Republic of Yugoslavia, have been significantly altered by the peaceful transi-
tion to democracy and other positive developments in Serbia and Montenegro 
(formerly the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (Serbia and Montenegro)). Ac-
cordingly, I hereby terminate the national emergencies declared in those 
orders and revoke those and all related orders (Executive Orders 12810 
of June 5, 1992, 12831 of January 15, 1993, 12846 of April 25, 1993, 12934 
of October 25, 1994, 13121 of April 30, 1999, and 13192 of January 17, 
2001).
